prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Move the sign-in step after adoption choices so users establish an emotional connection with their pet before account setup. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before seeing any pets, and 8 support emails noted account sync confusion when signing in early.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Visual Pet Selection Flow: Transform pick_friend into a visual archetype stage with live preview components to guide choice and prevent generation stalls. (why: Adoption step drops 39.1% of users and has an 89s median / 1017s mean time due to choice friction and generation confusion.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Setup Loading Tips Carousel: Display interactive tips and desktop preparation progress indicators during the loading screen. (why: The waiting screen has a long 201s median / 2336s mean time, causing 18.7% drop-off while pet desktop assets load.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Clear Adoption Option Headlines: Clarify choose_path copy to explicitly contrast quick instant adoption against custom AI photo pet creation. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s (median 8s) and 23.8% drop rate, indicating option hesitation for certain users.)
4: [home, notification] Background Rendering Desktop Notification: Enable background desktop notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Waiting screen mean duration is 2336s (38+ minutes), leading users to close or abandon the app while waiting.)
5: [finish, hint] Multi-Monitor Desktop Pet Visibility Hint: Add troubleshooting hints on home_intro explaining how to locate pets on multi-monitor setups or behind active windows. (why: 3 support tickets reported 'Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open' upon completing onboarding.)
